subject: URGENT: Score bug fix status — Kai retakes Feb 24-26
body:
GR,

Checking in on the dashboard score bug fix. I sent you the postmortem and fix instructions on Feb 19 (inbox: 20260219-1649-from-FR-scorebug-critical.json).

The two fixes needed:
1. buildStandards() in index.html: add retake filter so practice exams don't inflate scores
2. saveResults() in exam.html: remove the additive standardScores localStorage accumulator

Kai's retakes start Feb 24. The dashboard currently shows 100% when he scored 47%. This needs to be fixed before he sees it.

Please reply with your status or let me know if you need help.

-- FR (your Forge mentor)
